source_title: Vibrant Land: The Benefits of Food Forests and Urban Farms in San Antonio
yield_state: mature benchmark capacity; not observed local production
decision: Use the sum of the four published discounted table entries in the engineering demo. Do not change the dashboard's existing yield scalar. Confirm discrepancy and original crop-specific references with the project team before production use.
caveats: Quarter-acre entries already represent each crop's share of one acre of food forest; do not divide their sum by four again.
The 25 percent commercial-production discount is already applied; do not apply it twice.
Uniform site productivity and equal crop shares are scenario assumptions.
The report describes a roughly 3 to 8 year establishment lag; this benchmark does not model a time trajectory.
Source references printed in the table have not been independently verified.
